scope: Inventory of technical blockers only; no split reconstruction, raw-data changes, training, or approval.

blockers: Parent-flight and site groups are not established.
Empty image annotations need source-level interpretation; do not treat them as confirmed negatives without evidence.
existing_metadata: Phase 10G per-image index fields: path, source, split, image_id, categories, annotations.
SARD export folder and COCO filenames indicate a Roboflow v17 3x3-tile export.
Publisher/export documentation and original capture metadata may contain parent-frame, flight, site, and annotation-policy information.
metadata_gaps: No verified parent-frame, flight, or site identifier is present in the indexed records.
The annotation policy for empty images is not established.
tasks.required_work: Trace available source/export metadata without inventing capture identifiers; determine empty-annotation semantics and group complete parents before any split design.

blockers: 491 training frames are near test frames.
existing_metadata: Phase 10G index fields include path, split, task, and source class label.
Local source directories distinguish training and test files; the originating FLAME distribution documentation may identify source videos.
metadata_gaps: Parent-video or capture-session identifiers are not verified in the local index.
tasks.required_work: Resolve source-video lineage or independently review the near-test candidates; preserve original publisher splits until grouping is supported.

blockers: 2,003 masks do not have verified image pairs.
existing_metadata: Phase 10G index identifies the mask path and marks the task as unpaired_mask.
Local archive/directory names distinguish the mask component from classification frames.
metadata_gaps: No authoritative image-to-mask pair key is verified.
tasks.required_work: Locate an authoritative source pairing record or retain masks as unusable for paired training; do not infer pairs from filenames alone.

blockers: Publisher splits are known, but site/event independence is not established.
existing_metadata: Phase 10G indexes retain image paths, publisher split labels, source categories, and mask associations.
Publisher release documentation and image acquisition metadata may identify event, site, flight, or geographic groups.
metadata_gaps: No verified site/event key is present in the reviewed index.
tasks.required_work: Inspect existing publisher metadata for authoritative site/event groups before proposing any independent evaluation.

existing_metadata: Phase 10G index fields include path, sequence folder, modality, paired flag, annotation, and content hash.
Sequence-folder names distinguish visible and infrared streams; authoritative capture IDs, timestamps, calibration, and synchronization records may exist in the source release.
metadata_gaps: Folder similarity alone does not establish synchronized or geometrically aligned pairs.
The authoritative WiSARD edition and complete acquisition metadata are unverified.
tasks.required_work: Review flagged records and locate authoritative capture, synchronization, and calibration metadata; do not create pairs from folder names alone.

blockers: Four recording IDs cross official folds.
existing_metadata: The official metadata CSV includes filename, fold, category, target, source-file recording ID, and take fields.
metadata_gaps: The four cross-fold recording groups require a reviewed exclusion/benchmark disposition.
tasks.required_work: Use the official recording identifiers to keep or exclude complete recording groups; retain publisher folds as source evidence.

blockers: Four normalized whole-text keys cross publisher partitions.
Per-row event and original post identifiers are unavailable in the local Parquet schema.
existing_metadata: Three Parquet shard names encode train, validation, and test partitions; rows contain tweet_text and class_label.
The QCRI dataset card describes the event collection, but the inspected local rows do not map records to those events.
metadata_gaps: No row-level event, post, or source-recording identifier is available for group-level adjudication.
tasks.required_work: Review the complete duplicate text groups and seek authorized publisher metadata; do not infer event or author identity from text.

blockers: All seven events cross task partitions.
Pooling tasks repeats posts and image media across split names.
existing_metadata: Seven event TSVs retain event, post/image references, task labels, and publisher partitions.
The local image paths and content hashes identify exact repeated media; task-view indexes preserve task identity.
metadata_gaps: A combined unseen-event evaluation and the rights to underlying posts/media are unresolved.
tasks.required_work: Select a task-specific estimand, group event/post/media identity across task views, and resolve rights before any release.

blockers: Smoke Detection IoT and USGS records have no approved split assignments.
existing_metadata: Smoke source rows expose time, sensor channels, and the published alarm target; source project documentation may clarify collection runs.
USGS export retains period summaries and station/parameter metadata; the source API provides parameter and qualifier definitions.
metadata_gaps: No task-specific independent capture/run grouping or approved split policy is established.
tasks.required_work: Verify source metadata, chronology, and capture groups before defining a split; do not assign records during Phase 10I-A.

blockers: Prediction horizon and target definition are not specified across sensor tasks.
Channel units and source-specific missingness/qualifier semantics need explicit mapping.
Overlapping time windows may share measurements across partitions.
existing_metadata: Source CSV headers, timestamps, UCI data dictionary and missing-value sentinel, Smoke project/schema documentation, and USGS parameter/qualifier metadata.
Existing UCI day groups and timestamps support a future chronological purge analysis.
metadata_gaps: No approved target horizon, unit-normalization contract, or window-purge policy exists.
tasks.required_work: Document units and target horizons, define causal windows, and measure overlap only after Phase 10I-B is authorized.
